inj.note: A fifth-round pick in 2024, Monk started the first three games of the season at right guard and was called upon to man center Sunday against the Lions after Sean Rhyan exited with an ankle injury. With Rhyan out multiple weeks and Monk slated to miss at least four games, the Packers will likely turn to John Williams at center after he came on to play the first 58 offensive snaps of his career against Detroit on Sunday.
